findings.location: Definition, first paragraph (line 34): “every compact time-state cylinder C⊂D”; the assigned consumer uses this definition at Proof step 1.1.
findings.evidence: The published definition quantifies over compact time-state cylinders but does not define the sets that qualify as cylinders. The assigned theorem needs the property to supply one finite Lipschitz constant on K=[t0−h0,t0+h0]×closed-ball(x0,2r). This is valid under the usual product-cylinder interpretation, but that interpretation is unstated in the dependency; define the set class and its parameter analogue explicitly.

No diagrams were present; no assigned carrier was edited.
